title: Euler-Mascheroni Constant: Definition, Properties, and Open Rationality Question
description: Is the Euler-Mascheroni constant gamma rational or irrational? Formalize gamma's definition, convergence, bounds (1/2 < gamma < 2/3), and connection to harmonic series.

insights: Two approximating sequences: a_n = H_n - ln(n+1) increasing, b_n = H_n - ln(n) decreasing
gamma is positive and strictly between 0 and 1 (not an integer)
H_n = ln(n) + gamma + o(1) - the fundamental asymptotic
Rationality of gamma remains OPEN - one of the most famous unsolved problems
If gamma = p/q rational, then q > 10^242080 (Brent & Zudilin 2020)
Harmonic series at convergence boundary: p=1 diverges, p>1 converges
builtItems: gamma, gamma_seq, gamma_seq' definitions wrapping Mathlib API
Convergence theorems for both approximating sequences
Monotonicity: strictMono and strictAnti for the two sequences
